sources.title: Essink et al., Regimes of soft lubrication (2021)
sources.access: Publisher indexed text of equations 2.4, 2.5 and Table 1 retrieved; subsequent direct opens timed out. No PDF figures inspected or republished.
sources.used: Normal Fourier kernel of a layer bonded to a rigid base. Lubricated-flow results NOT used to claim dry ski lubrication.

sources.title: Menga, Carbone, Dini, Exploring the effect of geometric coupling on friction and energy dissipation in rough contacts of elastic and viscoelastic coatings
sources.used: Independent algebraic normal-kernel comparison; normal-tangential kernel ratio. Their full frictional/viscoelastic model is NOT rerun.

sources.title: Theile, Szabo, Luthi, Rhyner, Schneebeli, Mechanics of the Ski–Snow Contact (2009)
sources.access: Publisher HTML abstract, methods/discussion and conclusions read.
sources.used: Hard sintered snow at -6 C: deformation mechanisms and limited scope. Not a fresh-groomed-snow acceptance band; no 50 C polymer properties inferred.

sources.title: Arkema Pebax processing guidelines
sources.used: Film extrusion/coextrusion and stated 10 um film capability; not evidence of 1 um top skin or 190 um six-pad particles.

sources.title: Arkema PEBAX 4033 SP 01 product page
sources.access: Manufacturer HTML read; page indicates newer version. No exact-grade procurement authorized or performed.
sources.used: Example PEBA family: conditioned flexural modulus 77 MPa and melt 160 C as listed; neither used as 50 C dynamic Young modulus, fatigue guarantee, price, or safety evidence.

sources.title: Covestro Desmopan chemical properties
sources.used: Polyether TPU as comparative substrate family, with environment/grade dependence. Not completed-material safety or service-life proof.
